name: Memorizing Scripture
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital importance of internalizing God's Word by committing it deeply to the heart and soul, as seen in Deuteronomy 11:18 and Psalms 119:11. Meditating on and speaking the law continually, as Joshua 1:8 instructs, leads to wisdom, success, and a life aligned with God's will. This inward treasure of Scripture guards against sin and guides one's steps, reflecting the blessedness of living according to God's counsel described in Psalms 1 and 37.
